_note: Country-level funding that applies to every university in a country (optionally only public or private ones), e.g. Ukrainian state support for children of defenders. Same fact rules as university files: every scheme has source + status, and benefits are per academic year. `categories` limits a scheme to students who have one of those family/residence categories in their profile.

categories.label: Child of a combatant (УБД)
categories.description: A parent has combatant status (учасник бойових дій) from the Russian–Ukrainian war.

categories.label: Child of a fallen, missing or captured defender
categories.description: Family member of a defender who died, went missing in special circumstances, or was held captive (член сім'ї загиблого / зниклого безвісти захисника).

categories.label: Child of a person disabled due to the war
categories.description: A parent has disability status as a result of the war (особа з інвалідністю внаслідок війни).

categories.label: Internally displaced person (ВПО)
categories.description: Changed place of residence inside Ukraine after 24 Feb 2022.

categories.label: Lived in temporarily occupied territory
categories.description: Lived in territory occupied by Russia.

categories.label: Left Ukraine after 24 Feb 2022
categories.description: Was forced to move abroad after the full-scale invasion.

categories.label: Holds EU temporary protection in the country of study
categories.description: Registered under the EU Temporary Protection Directive in the country where the university is.

schemes.title: State compensation of contract tuition for children of defenders
schemes.eligibility: Children of combatants (УБД), of persons disabled due to the war, and of fallen, missing or captured defenders, studying on a paid (contract) place at a university of any ownership type (private universities included). The state pays the university, which refunds what the family already paid. Granted once, for one academic year only.
schemes.note: Experimental programme (CMU resolution No. 318 of 14 Mar 2025). Covered 2024/25, 2025/26 and 2026/27; not announced for 2027/28. One year of tuition, not the whole degree. Age limits and marital status rules apply: check the official conditions.

schemes.title: State targeted support (державна цільова підтримка) for children of combatants
schemes.eligibility: Full-time students up to age 23. Children of combatants: priority transfer from a paid place to a vacant state-funded place if their competitive score is no more than 15 points below the state-funded cut-off; preferential long-term study loan for paid places; social scholarship; free textbooks. Full payment of tuition on state-funded places.
schemes.note: CMU resolution No. 975 (2016). Children of combatants take the NMT like everyone else and have no admission quota. The transfer to a state-funded place depends on vacancies, so it is not guaranteed.

schemes.title: Quota 2 and transfer to a state-funded place for children of fallen defenders
schemes.eligibility: Children of fallen (deceased) or missing defenders: admission within quota 2 (up to 20% of state-funded places, lower cut-off) and mandatory transfer from a paid place to a state-funded one after enrolment. Full state targeted support (social scholarship, free dormitory, textbooks) until age 23.
schemes.note: Rules of the 2026 admission campaign; 2027 admission rules not published yet. Documents proving the status must be submitted before the first application.

schemes.name: State grant for paid places (державний грант)
schemes.amount_text: 18,500 UAH/yr (≈ €385) with 150+ in both NMT subjects; 27,000 UAH (≈ €560) with 170+; multiplied by a specialty coefficient
schemes.eligibility: Applicants enrolled on a paid place, by NMT score. Only at universities that signed up for the programme (state and private; KSE was listed in 2026). Paid to the university twice a year.
schemes.note: Introduced in 2025 and continued in 2026. 2027 amounts and participating universities not published yet. Converted at about 48 UAH/€.

schemes.title: Statutory (EU) fee for Ukrainians with temporary protection in the Netherlands
schemes.eligibility: Ukrainians registered in the Netherlands under the EU Temporary Protection Directive. Some universities charged them the statutory fee instead of the non-EU fee; others have ended this.
schemes.note: Policy differs per university and does not apply to students who come from Ukraine on a study visa. 2027/28 statutory fee about €2,771.
